question: Does conceptual thought exist in the individual means or is it absent there?
premises: An objection asks whether conceptual thought is absent in the individual means.
The text states that conceptual thought is present there.
The other means was defined by the absence of utterance.
inference: Conceptual thought belongs to the individual means, while absence of utterance characterizes another means.
plain_english: One might ask whether conceptual thought is absent in the individual means; it is present there, but the other means was defined as lacking utterance.
